entities.summary: Dutch Revolt (Eighty Years' War), a transformative movement in Netherlands (1566–1609). Emerged from Spanish and Charles V & Habsburg Centralisation. Catalyzed Union of Utrecht – foundation of the Dutch Republic and Assassination of William the Silent.
